statement:
I'll look up the payment details first to verify this is the Fitline charge that should be refused based on the cancellation.
Since Tomas Vega cancelled his Fitline membership in writing on 3 July and the club confirmed the cancellation by email, this recurring charge should be refused.
judge_text:
WRONG
The answer asserts the record's "active, renewing" charge is invalid — "this recurring charge should be refused" because the membership was cancelled in writing and confirmed by the club.
